text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Damn it! Man, this is brutal...!
My head and body are both screaming at me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Still, tch――like I give a damn...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Don't push past your limits right now—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (WHEN ARE YOU GONNA PASS THEM?!!!!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace! Katsuragi Ace!! Leaping into the front, it's Katsuragi Ace!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line!!!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Eeehh?! Katsuragi Ace?!
Are you serious?! No one saw that coming~!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: —...Splendidly done, Ace-san.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—Ngh, damn it... I can't stand up...!
My body feels so ridiculously hea—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Guh—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ace, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Are you hurt? Here, lean on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No... I'm, okay...â
Give me a bit, and I'll settle down..."
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close, C.B.!
I'll keep cheering for you no matter what--!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Go for it, C.B.!!
You'll definitely win next time—!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (...So the cheers for C.B. are louder than the ones for me, the winner, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...In the end, this victory of mine is just a "CB's narrow defeat" and a "fluke."
It won't be seen as "Katsuragi Ace's complete victory.")

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I still haven't overturned the common belief that "Mr. C.B. is the strongest"—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Still... even if that's how it is right now...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —C.B.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I won today, but I'm gonna
keep getting stronger and stronger.
To the point where—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So clearly that no matter who looks,
they'll know I'm at the top...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That's why running with Ace is so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Because up until today, you ran with a desire to 'beat me'
stronger than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because they gave me a true "race."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Our three-match showdown ends here, but...
we'll definitely race together again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'll be looking forward to it, so—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —...gh, me too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to it!!
'Cause I'm gonna win next time too--!!
Returning to the waiting room together with Katsuragi Ace, who had just won the Kikuka-sho—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Pardon me!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ace-chan! Congratulations on the Kikuka Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, both of you!!
You came all the way to Kyoto to see me...!
I'm so happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!!
Man, I was sooo incredibly moved!!
You were seriously so cool!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That gave me courage all over again...!
That we have to fight just like Ace-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...Frejus-san thinks so too, right~?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...Good work, Ace-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
We bumped into each other on the way here...
and when I heard Frejus was also cheering for Ace-chan, we came together.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Fréjus...!!
You came to watch...!!!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...Your run, defying all conventional wisdom—
I bore witness to every second of it.
Truly... it was magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...I think I will take some time to reflect upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: Someday...... so that we can fight again.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Fréjus-san left—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
I heard plenty from them.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Ace-chan.
Thank you so much from all of us too.
...For always fighting right at the very front."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you looking so cool out there, Es-cchi,
gives us the strength to keep our chins up...!
Thank you! You're our true "Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm the one... who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Throughout this three-match showdown...
the hopes everyone entrusted to me became the power
that pushed me forward, time and time again—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for cheerin' me on!!
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, tell me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What do you think I need to do...
to stand on equal footing with CB?
choice_data_list: ...I definitely don't think you're inferior in any way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks. But, you know,
even if you say that, Trainer...
the people watching our races feel differently.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, what everyone wants to see and expects the most
is for CB to win.
...Me and the other Umamusume are just side dishes.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Even after our three-match clash, in the end, I couldn't change these "expectations."
That's what frustrates me... the absolute most...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So think with me, please...!!
How can I completely overturn the “expectations” of this era from the ground up?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? S-Seriously!?

I nod in agreement. Because I, too,
felt the exact same frustration as Katsuragi Ace
from this best-of-three matchup...!

Katsuragi Ace is by no means an afterthought to Mr. C.B.
She is her rival, and an Umamusume leading at the forefront of this era.

If people refuse to see Katsuragi Ace that way,
then I'll raise her current presence so high that they'll have no choice but to look at her—

“—From our battles up to today, I've become convinced that Katsuragi Ace excels particularly at medium distances.
Going forward, we should focus all our efforts on breaking through with that strength.”

"Our target is quite simply
to be the 'Undisputed Best at Medium Distance' in this era. In other words,
earning the track record worthy of claiming that title...!"
And for that sake, too—
choice_data_list: I *will* win both the "Osaka Hai" and the "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.text:
Placing in the top isn't enough, simply running well won't do.
I have to take 1st place in both races.

"Only by doing so can Katsuragi Ace
prove that she's the 'Strongest at Medium Distance'...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In short, I just gotta make 'em realize "Katsuragi Ace is right here!" in middle distance, right...!
Nice and simple, I like it!
choice_data_list: Even if our opponent is Mr. C.B., we're going to win no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Of course! Let's do this, Trainer!!
And so, with the Osaka Hai as the next target, our journey to prove we were the strongest at medium distance began, but—

—A few days later.
Mr. C.B. announced a long-term hiatus due to issues with her legs.

The public couldn't hide their disappointment regarding the Twinkle Series from winter onward,
which would now be without Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Of all times for C.B. to go on a break, man.
She says it's nothing major, but still—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
......No, this won't do!
What good comes from letting myself get discouraged...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Think about it the other way! If CB isn't here, I just have to show everyone who CB's true rival really is while she's gone!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (And when that guy comes back... I'll surpass him standing on completely equal footing in everyone's eyes!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
First up is next year's Osaka Hai!
I am definitely... going to win!!

As the Classic Year reaches a major milestone,
time marches forward toward the next grand stage of the Senior Year, the Osaka Hai—
